decision: Needs Fixes: performance preservation and supported-hardware validation remain open
notes: Raw: GPU 1, CPU affinity 4-7; pipeline: GPUs 1,2, affinity 4-11; shared PCIe host, no NVLink.
Every timed process uses its complete imported checkout unchanged (--lookup default).
128 features, batch 32, hotness 4, D=64, float32, SGD; resident repeated keys 0..1023: warmed all-hit/high-overlap workload.
20 warmups; six trials of 100 steps; five separate profiled steps. No production HSTU, remote PS or NVLink speedup claim.
The r1/r2 repeat series overlapped a local validation job and is excluded from performance conclusions.
Initial HBM/cache runs have large CUDA memcpy/stream-wait delays; r3/r4 are subsequent ABBA repeats without another local validation job.
Storage r5/r6 use main,before,after,after,before,main order. External jobs still share the host; preserve all samples and outliers.
Existing input_dist_review_results.json remains historical 2026-11-13 / main8acc evidence.
Training extensions were rebuilt on main85 for both ABIs. Modified CU/headers were rebuilt with matching flags and linked with unchanged baseline objects; inference bindings disabled.
